messages:
Mira P: Quick sync — ACME Corp POC wants to stream user events via SSE through their corporate proxy, run tool calls (webhook callbacks), and get structured JSON output. They also asked about short-lived creds and pricing. Any known blockers? :wave:

Alex W: Hey Mira — we can do SSE + tool calls. Main questions: what TLS termination + proxy auth do they require? Do they need client certs or just outbound proxy with basic auth? Also what's qps and avg event size?

Mira P: They have outbound corporate proxy (auth via NTLM) and no client certs. QPS ~150 burst 400. Avg event 800 bytes. They want 99th p99 <200ms for streaming events to arrive at app.

Samir R: NTLM is a pain. Our hosted connectors currently support outbound proxy with username/pass env vars but not NTLM out of the box. For private deployment (VPC or onprem) we can run within customer's network and avoid NTLM. Two options:
- Quick: run a small adaptor in customer's network that does NTLM -> basic and forwards to our ingest endpoint
- Enterprise: Private deployment or gateway to avoid proxy translation

Alex W: For tool calls (webhook callbacks) we support outgoing webhooks with retries + dead-lettering. If callbacks must originate from customer's IP allowlist we can use dedicated egress IPs on Dedicated or Private.

Jordan (AM): Pricing note — streaming ingested events count toward tokens pricing only when we generate text. For pure event forwarding (structured JSON passthrough) billing is lower, see pricing page. I'll send them a cost estimate.

Mira P: Is there a sample adaptor or snippet we can share? Prefer a tiny node example.

Alex W: Yup. Small Node proxy sample:
```js
const http = require('http');
// basic NTLM->basic proxy sketch
http.createServer((req, res) => {
  // attach NTLM auth with corporate creds then forward
}).listen(8080);
```
I'll paste a more complete one in a follow-up.

Samir R: Also note: structured output -- if they want schema enforcement, use our structured output mode and pass schema param. It'll validate and return structured JSON. If strict validation fails we can fallback to lax mode.

Mira P: Security questionnaire — they sent a 70-question doc. Main asks: data residency, KMS integration, audit logs, SOC2. We have Private options + KMS + audit logs. Can someone own answers?

Jordan (AM): I'll take the questionnaire and draft answers with Security. Ping me if you need specifics. Mira, can you upload doc to sales drive?

eng-bot: Deploy check: Dedicated-eip pool has 3 available egress IPs in us-west-2.

Mira P: Uploaded the SSQ to drive: https://drive.example.com/ACME/presales/ssq.docx Thanks all — next step: Alex to share node proxy sample, Samir to confirm NTLM adaptor timeline, Jordan to send cost delta and questionnaire draft by EOD.

Alex W: On it. ETA for sample + quick runbook: today 1700 PT.

Samir R: I'll spike adaptor tomorrow, rough estimate 2 dev-days for hardened version.

Jordan (AM): Noted. I'll collate and send to ACME.
